tokenization: substring match (Python 'in' operator on lowercased text)
vector_construction: binary presence vector normalized to unit length
oov_behavior: all OOV tokens contribute 0.0; full-OOV queries produce a zero vector
zero_vector_behavior: zero cosine similarity with all documents; invisible to dense retrieval
normalization: L2 normalization (sqrt of sum of squares)
similarity_function: cosine similarity (via dot product of normalized vectors)

query_fully_unk.query: pharmacokinetics of lisinopril in elderly patients

gate5_impact: POS-01 query ('statin therapy is common') and RG-02 query ('Statin is a drug. Cyanide is a poison.') produce zero vectors. Dense retrieval is completely non-functional for these cases.
